name: Downtown Disney Jamba (Jamba Juice) Vanilla Blue Sky or Peach Perfection Smoothie (Citrus-Free Check!)
whyItWorks: Jamba's **Vanilla Blue Sky** (unsweetened almond milk, vanilla coconut milk, banana, pineapple, blue spirulina—100% dairy-free and citrus-free!) or **Banana Berry** (apple-strawberry juice, banana, blueberries, dairy-free) gives you cold soluble fiber and hydration walking between the parks and hotels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order **Vanilla Blue Sky** or a custom **Almond Milk + Banana + Peach + Mango** smoothie—strictly avoid Orange Dream Machine, Caribbean Passion, and White Gummi (all use orange/lime/lemon sherbet or juice!).
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS CHECK: Avoid Orange Dream Machine, Mango-A-Go-Go (contains passionfruit-orange-guava juice), and sour citrus smoothies
